focused: ios-protection-probe dispatch runs only seventh20m job. Closed paired and protection-host-only arms call fixed standalone Python entrypoints; all six full jobs skip. Helpers compile bounded Objective-C utilities with clang; paired owns its simulator, host-only does not. Neither invokes project Gradle build/test tasks, KMP framework linkage, productionAppleCheck or app XCTest.
stop_caveat: Not zero Gradle invocations: run_probe.py:850 stop invokes only gradlew --stop; HostProbe aliases that method. Preserve these mandatory stop/cleanup calls and JDK21 setup.
full: desktop-android,desktop-linux-arm64,desktop-macos-x64,desktop-windows-x64,ios,ios-release remain mandatory for full. No needs, strategy/matrix or job-level concurrency serialization; separate hosted checkouts may run concurrently subject to capacity. Runtime and release Apple lanes remain independent.
partition: Existing concurrency selects protection-<ref> only for explicit standalone protection, qualification-<ref> otherwise. Independently admitted protection/full may overlap without cross-group cancellation. Same-group cancel-in-progress remains true; account for older workflow group names and fresh source/control/resource guards.
recommendation: No further workflow move identified that improves this lane without altering reviewed gates/ownership or rebinding source. Keep Release LTO links, dependent framework/wrapper work, same-inode sample/comparison order and preserve/upload/cleanup/assert chains serial. Parallelize read-only evidence reconciliation/source review externally; existing partition already permits useful separate-run overlap.
final_run: Do not launch an extra full run merely to optimize scheduling. Inspect H02 and any genuinely needed diagnostic before final source freeze if it may drive corrections; batch reviewed changes then use one final same-source full qualification as required, never stitch focused passes into full.
limitations: Source/scheduling review only. Root-reported D09/H02 API success was not independently audited here and is not runtime/cleanup/readiness approval.
activity: Read-only Git/stdlib/hash and bounded workflow/helper/contract inspection; only this receipt written. No imports,validators,tests,builds,API,dispatch or process operations.
